e.title: LayerLoss (Lockton Re)
e.summary: 再保分层损失分配计算器：按起赔点/每次事故限额/年度聚合限额/ALAE 处理分配理赔到再保层
e.body: LayerLoss 是再保分保（cession）计算器（Lockton Re 关联）：根据起赔点（attachment points）、每次事故限额、年度聚合限额与三种 ALAE（分配理赔费用）处理方式，把保险理赔分配到再保险层。对 RIAA：再保险分层与止损结构的计算工具（配额/超赔分层分配）。与 [[reinsurer]]（再保建模）、[[reinsurance-networks]]（网络）、[[eltr]]（巨灾 ELT）互补。关联 [[reinsurance]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[aggregate-python]]（聚合损失）。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：再保分保计算器（attachment/限额/聚合/ALAE 三种处理），Lockton Re 关联
e.summary_en: Reinsurance cession calculator: allocates claims to reinsurance layers by attachment points, per-occurrence limits, annual aggregate limits and ALAE treatments
e.summary_hk: 再保分層損失分配計算器：按起賠點/每次事故限額/年度聚合限額/ALAE 處理分配理賠到再保層
e.body_en: LayerLoss is a reinsurance cession calculator (Lockton Re associated): allocating insurance claims to reinsurance layers based on attachment points, per-occurrence limits, annual aggregate limits and three ALAE (Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense) treatments. For RIAA: a calculation tool for reinsurance layering and stop-loss structures (quota/XL layer allocation). Complements [[reinsurer]] (reinsurance modelling), [[reinsurance-networks]] (networks) and [[eltr]] (cat ELT). Related: [[reinsurance]], [[actuarial-pricing]], [[aggregate-python]] (aggregate losses).
e.body_hk: LayerLoss 是再保分保（cession）計算器（Lockton Re 關聯）：根據起賠點（attachment points）、每次事故限額、年度聚合限額與三種 ALAE（分配理賠費用）處理方式，把保險理賠分配到再保險層。對 RIAA：再保險分層與止損結構的計算工具（配額/超賠分層分配）。與 [[reinsurer]]（再保建模）、[[reinsurance-networks]]（網絡）、[[eltr]]（巨災 ELT）互補。關聯 [[reinsurance]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[aggregate-python]]（聚合損失）。
